name: Sagara Chitose
source:
A girl in the same class as [url=/c95191]Souma[/url].

She is well-behaved and doesn't stand out. As she hates noisy places, she spends much time in the library room.

She's a girl who appears timid but on the contrary possesses great mental strength.

[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/418175]Ci-en[/url]]
